summary: MediWound Ltd. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a marketed follow-on offering of ordinary shares, NIS 0.07 par, listed on Nasdaq under MDWD; pricing terms, share count and proceeds were left blank in the preliminary filing. Last reported sale price was $13.50 on November 2, 2026. H.C. Wainwright is sole underwriter, with a 30-day option for additional shares. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch final pricing, discount to the $13.50 reference and dilution from the over-allotment.
